entities.summary: Joseph Goodall is an Australian professional boxer who has held the WBC Australasia heavyweight title since March 2021. As an amateur he won a silver medal at the 2014 Commonwealth Games and bronze at the 2017 World Championships, becoming Australia's first medalist at the World Championships since 1991.
